---
title: "simstim host add"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connect a host: check it, install the helper, prepare it.

```text
simstim host add [<name>] [<ssh-target>] [flags]
```

Connect a host, pin its SSH host key and install the helper. The ssh target is a Host from your SSH config, or user@host. It defaults to the name. `--ssh-config` adds an extra SSH config file, for example a repo's own. `--host-key` pins the host key with the given SHA256 fingerprint instead of asking OpenSSH. `--trusted` marks the host as trusted (you control root on it); hosts default to untrusted.

On a Mac, `--local` sets up this Mac as a host in a pinned Lima VM under your own account, started automatically with limactl autostart.

## Examples

```sh
simstim host add my-vps
simstim host add my-vps dev@203.0.113.10
simstim host add my-vps dev@203.0.113.10 --host-key SHA256:… --trusted
simstim host add --local
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--autostart <string>` | `--local`: start VM automatically: boot, login or off (default boot) |
| `--cpus <int>` | `--local`: VM CPUs (default: under half of this Mac) |
| `--disk <int>` | `--local`: VM disk in GiB (sparse, default 40) |
| `--floor <string>` | weakest sandbox level to pin: none, process, gvisor or microvm |
| `--host-key <string>` | pin the host key with this SHA256 fingerprint (SHA256:…) |
| `--idle-stop <string>` | `--local`: idle power-off time, or never (default never) |
| `--label <string>` | labels, for example provider=gcp,region=eu |
| `--local` | set up this Mac as a host in a pinned Lima VM |
| `--memory <int>` | `--local`: VM memory in GiB (default: under half of this Mac) |
| `--provider-script <string>` | a script that starts and stops the host (see examples/providers) |
| `--ssh-config <string>` | an extra SSH config file to include |
| `--trusted` | mark the host as trusted (you control root on it) |
| `--wake` | start the host through its provider script when it does not answer |
| `-y`, `--yes` | install the helper without asking, pin an unknown host key on first use, and offer no agents to install |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |
| `--no-color` | print no colour (NO_COLOR does the same) |
| `--no-input` | ask nothing: a question that needs an answer fails with exit code 4, and names the flag that answers it (SIMSTIM_NO_INPUT=1 does the same) |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
